svg.title: Pacific NEC nominal near-surface span
svg.desc: Qiu et al.2015 project synthesis describes a nominal8-17 degrees north band west of the dateline. WGS84 meridional conversion gives about1000km. Regional approximation; no paired physical edges, annual range or numerical uncertainty. The related JPO7-17N band is separate source context.

g.text: Nominal near-surface span · western Pacific, west of the dateline
Derived meridional distance from the reported 8–17°N band
Regional summary · near-surface context shallower than 100 m
Paired physical edges, annual range and numerical uncertainty: unknown
Related JPO paper describes 7–17°N; keep that source context separate.
Qiu et al.2015 · Oceanography 28(4), p25 · doi:10.5670/oceanog.2015.78
Nominal width candidate · whole-current length and seasonal playback unresolved
